notes: Round 3: post-acceptance bug fix, flagged by Damilola (found incidentally while testing her own unrelated BIO-UX-012 work) and relayed via god. Real bug: the People list only ever rendered a Suspend action, never a symmetric Reinstate one - a person suspended directly from the list had no way back to active without first navigating to their detail page (which always had both and worked correctly the whole time, which is why the story's original detail-page-only test never caught it). Reproduced directly with a throwaway Playwright probe before fixing. Fix: handleSuspend generalised to handleLifecycleAction(personId, kind), Reinstate now renders on the list whenever lifecycleStatus === 'suspended', mirroring the detail page. Added a regression test exercising both directions without leaving /people. Also hardened this story's own wizard 'Next' button Playwright locators with exact:true (Next.js's dev-mode 'Open Next.js Dev Tools' overlay button's accessible name contains 'Next' as a substring - same report from Damilola, flagged separately to Emeka as shared dev-mode test-infra, not this story's bug). Also skipped bio-ux-005-adapter-framework.spec.ts's 'no backend-port mapping' test with an explanation - BIO-UX-007 has since replaced /nfc-uhf (this test's prior retarget) with a real screen, and route-manifest.ts's only two remaining Unassigned entries (/alumni, /contractors) were already given real screens by this same story, so no route currently exists for that test's premise. See docs/features/bio-ux-006/README.md's 'Post-acceptance fix: list-level Reinstate' section for the full record. Verified: tsc/next build clean, 371/371 vitest unit tests, 202/204 Playwright (1 newly skipped as above, the same 2 pre-existing dev-only feature-mode-panel failures otherwise unaffected), scripts/quality.sh QUALITY PASS 0 failures.
